team.title: Our Leadership Team
team.intro: The firm is organized around two departments, each led by a Partner, combining rigorous international methodology with deep roots in Senegalese law and practice.

departments.ibrahima_desc: The Legal and Tax Department leads all of the firm's consulting, litigation, and legal/tax structuring missions: corporate law, labor law, corporate and group taxation, civil and commercial litigation, contracts, intellectual property, and regulatory support for operations conducted by the firm's clients.
departments.saliou_desc: The Corporate Finance Department handles the financial engineering of operations: transaction structuring, capital arrangements, fundraising, business valuation, and supporting clients in their growth, restructuring, or equity investment operations.
